_comment: Merge into settings.json under `hooks`. On session stop, append a brief summary of changes to .agents/reports/session-log.md. POSIX shell assumed; on Windows use Git Bash or WSL.

hooks.command: mkdir -p .agents/reports && { echo "# Session $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"; git status --short; echo; git diff --stat; echo; } >> .agents/reports/session-log.md
